takeaways: Manual canvas app design creates inconsistent, hard-to-maintain interfaces whose technical debt grows with every handcrafted screen.
Generative pages produce React code bound to Dataverse metadata, which enforces consistent design and security, but the output is read-only and must be regenerated through prompts.
Use manual UI for unique experiences, AI pages for repeatable enterprise apps, and a hybrid with versioned, standardized prompt templates for long-term governance.
hook: Still nudging buttons pixel by pixel in Power Apps while others describe a page and let AI build it? This episode is for makers and Power Platform leads weighing canvas apps against generative pages and vibe coding. You will learn where AI-generated pages save real time, where they create new kinds of technical debt, and how a hybrid approach with governed prompts gets the best of both.
